page: Microsoft Azure E96bs_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance based on the x86_64 Intel processor architecture and hosted on Microsoft Hyper-V. The system is provisioned with 96 dedicated vCPUs and 768 GB of system memory, establishing an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio with 8.0 GB of RAM allocated per virtual core.

The instance does not include integrated GPU acceleration or local ephemeral storage. Storage operations rely entirely on remote block storage, with the Ebsv6 family specifically engineered to support high-throughput remote volume attachments including Azure Premium Storage. Additionally, the instance provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses by default.

By delivering dedicated compute cores paired with a substantial memory footprint and optimized block storage connectivity, the E96bs_v6 addresses infrastructure demands where memory capacity is the primary constraint. It is suitable for large-scale relational databases, enterprise in-memory caches, large business applications, and memory-intensive analytics workloads.
